sites.name: Peak near Cabeus B
sites.source_note: Region name from the NASA 2024-10 release. Position read from the yellow region box center in the release map (no lat/lon grid is printed). Method: south pole star at pixel (745.8,762.4) taken as the pole, scale bar 50 km = 179 px, map top taken as 0 deg longitude with east to the right (checked: Malapert Massif lands near 0E and 86S). Polar stereographic inverse, R=1737.4 km. Estimated error a few km; the NTRS abstract (ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20250011660) gives no coordinates. Representative point of a region that holds several landing sites, not a landing site.
